'''Janine Pavarla''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is 5'3" and plump, with large dark eyes and luxuriant black hair, which she wears pulled into a bun on the back of her neck. 

== Strength and Abilities ==
Janine is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|33}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

==History==
She was born in {{ne|963}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in [[978 NE]]. After spending eleven years as a [[novice]] and nine years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the Red Ajah in [[998 NE]]. Since she is new to the shawl, she has not yet achieved the ageless look.{{ref/book|7|1}} It was for this reason that she, along with [[Beldeine Nyram]] and [[Marith Riven]], was chosen to participate in [[Rand al'Thor]]'s kidnapping.{{ref/book|6|51}}

==Activities==
She was on the White Tower secret expedition to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].

She was captured by the [[Asha'man]] at the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]{{ref/book|6|55}}.

[[Chisaine Nurbaya]], Janine Pavlara, [[Innina Darenhold]] and [[Vayelle Kamsa]] are the last four of the prisoners to swear fealty to Rand{{ref/book|9|13}}. They did so under [[Verin]]'s [[Compulsion]].

As with many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Janine probably fought the [[Last Battle]] on the slopes of [[Thakan'dar]]{{ref/book|14|34}}. It is not stated whether she survived or not.
